selection_rationale: Reference RF systems from the two makers that dominate wireless microphone and in-ear monitoring catalogues (Sennheiser, Shure), covering analog FM (ew 100 G4, the classic school/theatre kit), the digital generations that replaced it (EW-DX, SLX-D, QLX-D, ULX-D, Digital 6000, Axient Digital), the analog IEM families (PSM 300/900/1000, ew IEM G4), antenna distribution (Shure UA845UWB, Sennheiser EW-D ASA, ADP UHF) and camera/ENG receivers (Sennheiser EW-DP EK, Wisycom MCR54). For every system the manufacturer's European/French band variants are recorded, and notes point to ARCEP's page on PMSE bands in France. Sony UWP-D and Lectrosonics could not be sourced (manufacturer sites blocked automated fetches and the session web-search budget was exhausted).

devices.notes: The manual confirms SMA antenna connectors, a Mini XLR 5-pin output carrying analog or AES3, a TA5 top-feed AUX option, 6-18 VDC on a Hirose connector, and a '470-800MHz tuneable filter with 32MHz of bandwidth'. The connector id mini-xlr-ta4 is the closest available; the real connector is TA5 (proposed id mini-xlr-ta5). The antenna input count (2) is assumed for a true diversity receiver. FR regulation (ARCEP): the EU bands B12/B2 include 470-800 MHz and 823-832 MHz; in France only 470-694 MHz and 823-832 MHz are open to PMSE without individual authorisation, and 694-789 MHz has been closed since 1 July 2019. Status 'current' is inferred because the page files it under current products.
